decisions.reason: The low-pile decorative carpet stays close to the firm's textile and interior know-how. The firm can keep reading market feedback and refining it within its collection, although the earlier pruning of a similar low-pile carpet points to some ongoing rationalisation risk.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet rests directly on the firm's material expertise and craftsmanship. That gives it a stable premium position the firm understands well.

The firm has the related knowledge to manage this decorative carpet. Its overlap with other low-pile carpets, after Product E was already withdrawn, keeps the risk of further range consolidation somewhat elevated.
The corner bench extends the firm's core seating and customization competence. This lets it adapt the product for residential and hospitality projects with confidence.
The swivel shell chair line builds on deep seating knowledge and serves both workplace and residential markets. The firm can interpret results across its several models and keep improving them.
